description: Source code for BluetoothAudioSource class implementing Bluetooth audio source client functionality, including callback management, stream configuration, and state handling.

classes.name: AudioSource
classes.description: Client class managing Bluetooth audio source, callbacks, stream configuration, and state transitions.

classes.name: Receiver
classes.description: Handles receiving audio frames in a separate thread, managing buffer and invoking parent callback.

classes.name: Callback
classes.description: Implements callback interface for Bluetooth audio source state changes.

classes.name: SinkStream
classes.description: Implements IStream interface for sink operations, forwarding calls to parent.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of AudioSource.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Deletes singleton instance of AudioSource.

methods.name: RegisterOperationalStateUpdateCallback
methods.description: Registers callback for operational state updates.

methods.name: UnregisterOperationalStateUpdateCallback
methods.description: Unregisters callback for operational state updates.

methods.name: RegisterSourceStateChangedCallback
methods.description: Registers callback for source state changes.

methods.name: UnregisterSourceStateChangedCallback
methods.description: Unregisters callback for source state changes.

methods.name: SetSink
methods.description: Sets sink callbacks and user data.

methods.name: Relinquish
methods.description: Relinquishes the source stream.

methods.name: Speed
methods.description: Sets the speed of the source stream.

methods.name: Time
methods.description: Gets current playback time.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Retrieves current Bluetooth audio source state.

methods.name: Device
methods.description: Retrieves connected device address.

methods.name: Operational
methods.description: Handles operational state changes, initializes or cleans up interfaces.

methods.name: OnConfigure
methods.description: Configures sink stream with specified format.

methods.name: OnAcquire
methods.description: Acquires sink for streaming.

methods.name: OnRelinquish
methods.description: Relinquishes sink and stops streaming.

methods.name: OnSetSpeed
methods.description: Sets sink stream speed.

methods.name: OnGetTime
methods.description: Retrieves current playback time.

methods.name: OnGetDelay
methods.description: Retrieves current delay in samples.

methods.name: OnFrameReceived
methods.description: Callback invoked when a frame is received, forwards to sink callback.

methods.name: ConvertState
methods.description: Converts internal state enum to external Bluetooth source state.
